data.sub: Test cricket mein chhakka lagakar shatak pure karne wale top 3 बल्लेबाज

chat.say: Test match ko T20 bana diya bhai ne!
Araam se khelna mana hai kya?

data.asar: Ground par chhakka dekhne ka maza hi alag hai bhai.
data.caption:
Test match ho ya T20, chhakke ki awaaz sabko pasand aati hai! 🏏

• Sachin ne Test me 6 baar chhakka lagakar shatak pura kiya
• Pant ne 4 baar yeh karke record banaya
• Top 3 batsmen ki list me shamil hue

Save kar lo, baad mein kaam aayega!
